content: Sair hazar manušore hána diye
Ar ek bar hẽtte ek ḍõr mainšor dol dola oiye, edde hitarattu háibolla kissu nu aššil. Toi Isaye sahabi okkolore hibar hãse ḍaikke edde hodde,

content.text: "Ei manuš okkololla ãr dilot doya or, kiyollahoile itara aijja tin din dori ãr fũwati ase, ar hitarattu háibolla hono kissu nai.
Zodi ãi itarare uwašša górot defeṛai toile hitara fõtot bangi fori zaiboi, kiyollahoile eṛe kiye kiye bout durottu aiššede ase."

content: Sahabi okkole hodde, "Ei nirzon zagat itarare habaibolla edun ruṭi hontu faibo?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwarar hãse howa ruṭi ase?"

content: Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Hãttuwa"

Toi hibaye manuš okkolore meṛit boibolla hokum diye. Bade he ruṭi hãttuwa loi hibaye Allare šukuriya zanaiye, hinore bangi hibar sahabi okkolore diye zene hitara manuš okkolore baṛi de, ar hitara hinore manuš okkolore baṛi diye.
Hitarattu hougguwa šoṛo mas o aššil. Hibaye hinore loi duwa goijje edde hin o hitarare baṛi dito hoiye.
Ar hitara feṭ bori hái faijje, tarfore ze ṭura okkol fori roiye hin sahabi okkole tuli loiyore hãt barang oiye.
Heṛe onumanik sair hazar manuš aššil. Tarfore hibaye hitarare bidai diye.
Ar hibaye sahabi okkolore loi hehon not giye edde Dalmanuta elehat aišše.
Foroši okkole aišše edde Isa loi barabari gora suru goijje. Hibare forikka goribolla hitara hibare behostottu ekkan sinno dehaito hoiye.
Henot hibaye dilor beši murottu dukke hodde,

content.text: "Ei halor manuš okkole sinno kiyolla tuwa? Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, itarare hono sinno deha no oibo."

content: Tarfore hibaye hitarare eri zai abar not uṛi dusora farot giye.
Išottu hũšiyar
Kintu sahabi okkolottu ruṭi loite monot nuaššil, hitarattu šude ugguwa ruṭi bade not maze ar hono kissu no aššil.
Hen šomot Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara hũšiyar, Foroši edde Herudor išottu šabdan taikko."

content: Kintu hitara hitara howa hoi goijje: "Ãrattu ruṭi nai boli hibaye ei hota hodde."
Isaye hitara ki hodde buzi fariyore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwarattu ruṭi naide he babute kiyolla howahoi goror? Tũwara ehono buzi no faro ne? Tũwarar dil ki koṭin oigiyegoi neki?
Tũwarattu suk takiyore o ki deki no faror? Han takiyore o ki funi no faror? Ar tũwarattu monot nai ne?
Ãi zẽtte fãs hazar manušolla fãswa ruṭi bangilam hẽtte tũwara ho barang ruṭir ṭura feṛai loi dola goijjila?"

content: Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Baro barang"

content.text: "Ar ãi zẽtte he sair hazarolla hãttuwa ruṭi bangilam hẽtte tũwara ho barang ruṭir ṭura feṛai loi dola goijjila?"

content: Hitara hodde "Hãt barang"
Hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Toile tũwara ehono kissu buzi no faror?"

content: Betsaidar anda manušwa
Bade hitara Betsaidat aišše, heṛe hodun mainše ekzon andare Isar hãse loi aišše, ar he manušware suibolla hibare foriyad goijje.
Isaye he anda manušware hate dori farar baire loigiye. Tarfore hitar sukot sef diye edde hitar uwore hat raikke edde fusar goijje,

content.text: "Tui ki hono kissu dekor ne?"

content: Hite saiye edde hodde, "Ãi manušore dekir, hitarare saite gasor ḍoilla, aṛerfan lager."
Ar ek bar Isaye he manušwar sukor uwore hat raikke. Toi suk kuligiyegoi, ar hite aram oiye edde beggun foriškar gori deki faijje.
Isaye en hoiyore hitare górot faṭai diye,

content.text: "Farar butore no zais."

content: Fitore Mosi šikar gorer
Isa edde hibar sahabi okkol Sesariyar Filifir atehasor šohoror okkolot aišše, fõtot hibaye hitarare fusar goredde,

content.text: "Ãi honnuwa, ei babute manuš okkole ki ho?"

content: Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Torikotor gusol doya Yahya, kintu kiye kiye ho nobi Eliyas, ar kiye ho nobi okkolor butottu ek nobi."
Toi hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Ar tũwara, tũwara ki ho ãi honnuwa?"

content: Toi Fitore zuwab diye, "Õne he Mosi."
Isaye hitarare hũšiyari diye zene hitara hibar babute honokiyore no ho.
Isaye nizor moron edde uwafes zindar babute hor

Bade Isaye hitarare šikka diya šuru goijje ze Adomor Futottu beši duk bug gora foribo edde hibare murobbi okkol, ḍõr imam okkol edde alem okkole batil goribo. Hibare mari fela oibo, edde tin dinor din bade abar uṛi zaibogoi.
Hibaye ei babute kulasa gori hoiye. Toi Fitore hibare ek ḍaikka loizaiyore jejeṛaiye.
Kintu Isaye firiyore sahabi okkolor mikka saiye edde Fitorore dõk diyore hodde,

content.text: "Šoitan, ãr hãsottu dur o, Allaye ziyan issa gorer tottu hiyanor baf nai, kintu šude manuše ziyan sa hiyan bafos."

content: Isar fisa lowa
Toi hibaye sahabi okkol edde oinno manuš okkolore ḍakiyore hodde,

content.text: "Honokiye zodi ãr fise aito issa gore, hite nizore ošikar gorok edde hite fotti din nizor kuruš handot loi ãr fise fise aiyok.
Kiyollahoile ze honokiye hitar nizor zibon basaito sa hite hiyan haraibo, kintu ze kiye ãlla boli edde kušir hóborolla hitar foran hara hite hiyan basaibo.
Zodi ekzone šara duniyai hamaiye, kintu hitar asol foran haraifele, toile hitar ki lab oiye?
Ar hite ki kissu diyore asol foran hiyan uwafes firai faibolla kissu ase?

Ei halor beiman edde gunagar manuš okkolor butore zodi honokiye ãre edde ãr hota loi šorma, Adomor Fut zẽtte pak fobitro firista okkolor fũwati hibar Bafor tozolli loi aibo, hẽtte hibaye o he manuš okkolore šormaibo."
